title: The idea of Tollgate in four steps
desc: First the tests are written; they say what done means. Then they are locked on GitHub, where the AI cannot change them. The AI builds, and may try again, but cannot move the goal. The locked tests decide: only a change that passes them is merged.

nodes.text:
Write the tests
They say what
done means

Lock them
On GitHub, where the
AI cannot change them

The AI builds
It can try again.
The tests stay the same.

The tests decide
Only a change that
passes is merged
